conviction_note: The 9M26 numbers are new: there was no trading update, and OHLA's own results-day moves were -9.7, +6.5, +15.9 and -2.3. So abs_move is 7.5. The lean is mildly negative (p_up 45) because Q3 cash carries the July Flaggers payment and order intake is running behind the c.4.4bn guide. EBITDA is on track for the >215M guide, and the stock has already lost a third since May. The findings sum to -2.2 and the scaled number is -0.75. The gap is uncertainty about the sign, held in p_up. It is not a disagreement about direction.

already_public.what: 1H26 results. Sales 1,749.0M (continuing ops). Recurring EBITDA 116.9M (124.4M incl. Servicios), reported 103.6M incl. Servicios after the -20.8M Flaggers hit. Contracting 1,838.3M incl. Servicios (book-to-bill 0.9x). Recourse liquidity 711.3M against 847.4M at Dec-25. Operating cash flow -90.6M, Q2 activity cash +96.4M. Flaggers payment made in July 2026 from Judlau resources. 'el Grupo mantiene sus previsiones para el conjunto de 2026'
FY2026 targets: sales >4.1bn EUR, EBITDA >215M EUR, contracting c.4.4bn EUR

Sale process for the Czech subsidiary OHLA ZS (2025 sales 528M) disclosed to the CNMV. Alimarket says the sale aims to reduce debt and comply with the limits set by bondholders and banks. Stock -3.3% that day
Mexico cancelled the Queretaro-Saltillo rail sub-section tender (OHLA consortium had the highest of five bids, about 1.2bn EUR ex-VAT). The bid was never in backlog
EGM convened for 16 Nov (first call) / 17 Nov 12:00 (second call, the one expected): 10:1 reverse split, buyback authorisation, board size and appointments

new_in_release.expect: Q3 liquidity and working capital. The July Flaggers payment falls in Q3, and the company said it would recover the cash effect 'durante la segunda mitad del ejercicio o principios del 2027'. Q3 2025 generated only +13M from activity. I expect recourse liquidity below the June 711.3M, with some downside risk.

The FY26 guide will probably be reiterated, with EBITDA on track. Order intake is the line at risk: 42% of the c.4.4bn target at H1, and no large Q3 award found beyond Santiago L9 (144.3M). There is some chance of a trimmed contracting target or a book-to-bill below 1. Leans negative.
Construction margin about 7% and EBITDA in line with the guide's pace. Neutral to mildly positive.
Peru ANIN guarantees (115M EUR, frozen by injunction) and the disposals (Servicios/Ingesan, OHLA ZS). Unknown, two-sided.

findings.finding: Q3 2026 cash absorbs the Flaggers payment made in July (H1 hit: -20.8M EBITDA, -26.6M net), on top of H1 operating cash flow of -90.6M and receivables up 252M. The company only promised to recover the cash effect in H2 'o principios del 2027', so 9M recourse liquidity is likely to print below the 711.3M June level, and local previews name cash as the line the market will read.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 9M25 (27/11/2025): only +13M Q3 activity cash and a net loss; next session -9.73% (Yahoo daily bars). 1H26 (13/08/2026): Q2 cash +96.4M but liquidity down from Dec; -2.26%.
findings.original_quote: se prevé compensar el efecto en la caja durante la segunda mitad del ejercicio o principios del 2027 ... el pago asociado los Flaggers (ya explicado) se efectuó en el mes de julio de 2026 y, por tanto, con posterioridad al cierre del semestre (we expect to offset the cash effect in H2 or early 2027 ... the Flaggers payment was made in July 2026, i.e. after the half-year close)
findings.why_not_priced: The payment is public but its size in the cash line is not. Nobody publishes a 9M liquidity estimate, and the baseline carries no consensus. If the market had priced a clean Q3 cash recovery, the stock would not sit 19% below its June close (0.4566) on unchanged guidance.
findings.independence: Forobolsa preview (16/11/2026) names liquidity at September as the first thing to read and recalls the July payment: https://forobolsa.es/noticias/314-resultados-ohla-el-martes-manda-la-caja-no-el-contrasplit. Same underlying document, so the support is weak.

findings.finding: Order intake is behind the FY26 contracting target of c.4.4bn: 1,838.3M at H1 (42%, book-to-bill 0.9x). The largest Q3 award found is Santiago Metro L9 at 144.3M (28/07/2026), and the 1.2bn Queretaro bid was cancelled on 30 Oct. That raises the risk of a sub-1 book-to-bill at 9M or a trimmed contracting target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 9M25 printed book-to-bill 1.2x yet fell -9.73% on other lines. No observed case of a contracting-guide cut.
findings.original_quote: Contratación: c.4,4Bn€ (2026 target) / 'La Contratación Total del Grupo en el semestre ascendió a 1.838,3 millones de euros, lo que representa una ratio book-to-bill de 0,9x' (1H26 report)
findings.why_not_priced: Q3 awards are disclosed piecemeal in press releases and nobody aggregates them against the target. A market that had priced a contracting shortfall would not still be reading the Queretaro cancellation as 'expectations only' (Forobolsa). This rests on not finding large Q3 awards, so it is kept small.
findings.independence: Interempresas on the L9 award (28/07/2026): https://www.interempresas.net/ObrasPublicas/659968-Ohla-consigue-un-contrato-de-144-3-millones-en-el-Metro-de-Santiago-de-Chile.html. findings.finding: EBITDA is on track for the >215M FY26 target: 1H26 recurring EBITDA incl. Servicios 124.4M (58%), reported 103.6M (48%), construction margin 7.3%, and the guide was reiterated in August. This lands inside the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 1Q26 EBITDA +90.9% and return to profit: +15.93% on 25/05/2026. FY25 'all targets met': +6.47%. 9M25 EBITDA +30% in line: -9.73%.
findings.original_quote: el EBITDA recurrente (ex impacto temporal Flaggers) del Grupo se sitúa en los 116,9 millones de euros, +39,0% ... Asimismo, el Grupo mantiene sus previsiones para el conjunto de 2026 (recurring EBITDA ex-Flaggers 116.9M, +39.0% ... the Group maintains its 2026 forecasts)

findings.finding: Peru: ANIN tried to call 446.7M soles (about 115M EUR) of performance and advance guarantees on four terminated contracts (about 315M of backlog). The guarantees are held by injunctions, and balance-sheet exposure was 61.8M at June. Any change in the 9M litigation note is two-sided but skewed to the downside.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Kuwait guarantee call (39.8M) was reported by Forbes as -8% on the day (date not confirmed). No Peru-specific reaction observed.
findings.original_quote: la ANIN intentó ejecutar las garantías de cumplimiento y de anticipos, por 446,7 millones de soles, unos 115 millones de euros ... los administradores no consideran probable sufrir pérdidas (ANIN tried to call guarantees of 446.7M soles, about 115M EUR ... management does not consider losses probable)
findings.why_not_priced: The risk sits in a note to the interim accounts, not in any CNMV release or headline. There is no sign either way since June, so the central size is small and the left tail is wide.
findings.independence: ANIN official statement cited in the article: https://www.gob.pe/institucion/anin/noticias/1363621-respecto-los-contratos-suscritos-entre-la-empresa-ohla-y-la-ex-arcc; GAR on interim relief: https://globalarbitrationreview.com/article/ohla-secures-interim-relief-against-peruvian-state-agency

findings.finding: Disposal processes are open: Servicios/Ingesan (about 100M, discontinued) and the Czech subsidiary OHLA ZS (2025 sales 528M). Alimarket says the sale aims to reduce debt and stay within limits set by bondholders and banks. A firm agreement announced with the 9M release would be positive, and the covenant framing offsets part of it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Announcement of the Czech sale process: -3.3% on the day (15/09/2026). Canalejas split completion (29/04/2026): no measured reaction.
findings.original_quote: Tan pronto como el consejo de administración de la Compañía adopte un acuerdo firme de venta se comunicará al mercado (As soon as the board adopts a firm sale agreement it will be communicated to the market)
findings.why_not_priced: Neither the timing nor the price of either deal is public, and the stock fell 3.3% on the process announcement. That means the market read the sale as covenant-driven rather than as value. A signed price would be new information.
findings.independence: Merca2 on the Servicios sale process (03/06/2026): https://www.merca2.es/2026/06/03/venta-ohla-servicios-100-millones-2388912/

findings.finding: The EGM is held on the same day (17 Nov, 12:00, second call), after the release. It votes a 10:1 reverse split and a buyback authorisation. The concert party holds 29.429%, so a buyback would push it toward the 30% bid threshold.
findings.original_quote: Autorización para que la Sociedad pueda proceder a la adquisición de acciones propias, directamente o a través de sociedades de su Grupo (Authorisation for the Company to acquire its own shares, directly or via group companies)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, because the agenda has been public since 14 Oct. The only residual is whether management signals actual buyback use during the meeting.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly negative, against a +10.4% 20-day bounce, so they cut against the run-up, but they agree with the -11.7% 60-day trend and the one-third drawdown since May. That is why p_up sits at 45 and not lower.
language_note: The CNMV OIR 43624 (Spanish) confirmed the 17 Nov morning release before the EGM. English aggregators carried a wrong date (26/11/2026) and nothing on the time of day.
Alicante Plaza carried Squarepoint's 0.60% net short (13 Oct, building from 0.50%). It is the only positioning datum available, since the CNMV register is unreadable here; no English source had it.

The Spanish 1H26 report and the Forobolsa notes carried the July timing of the Flaggers payment, the 115M EUR Peru guarantees, and the 'H2 or early 2027' cash-recovery wording. English summaries (The Corner, Quartr) gave only the headline EBITDA and profit.
Alimarket (Spanish) tied the Czech subsidiary sale to compliance with bondholder and bank limits. Forobolsa carried the Queretaro tender cancellation from Mexican sources.
The EGM agenda (reverse split, buyback authorisation) on the same day as the print came from Spanish CNMV and press only.
lessons_applied: 'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco): the Q3 cash/working-capital finding goes from -1.0 to -1.2 and its low end widens to -4.0. Working capital is the line to sign on when the guide is merely reiterated.
'A finding that lands inside what the company guided goes toward 0': the EBITDA-on-track finding goes from +0.3 to +0.2.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move' / understatement: abs_move_pct goes from 7.0 to 7.5, anchored on this name's own observed results-day moves (-9.7, +6.5, +15.9, -2.3) rather than the baseline's cadence-estimated 3.51 median.
'Session check: open with the verdict and a timestamp': session_check opens with 'bmo' and cites the CNMV OIR URL. p_up is unchanged at 45.
